shaban_prep.title: A Quiet Quran Corner at Home
shaban_prep.subtitle: Preparing a gentle family nook where reading feels welcoming and calm
steps: Choose a clean, calm spot with your child for the Mushaf and a small prayer mat.
Tidy it together with a warm smile and give each child a paper bookmark in their favorite color.
shaban_prep.child_role: Straighten the prayer mat and place your bookmark in the family surah.

shaban_prep.title: Our Paper Lantern Made by Hand
shaban_prep.subtitle: Welcoming Ramadan with a warm, screen-free paper craft
steps: Open the Ramadan Printable Kit to cut out one paper lantern or hang the 30-Lantern Street sheet.
Share one kind hope for the month together without pressure or scorecards.
shaban_prep.child_role: Pick the brightest spot to tape or hang your first paper lantern.

shaban_prep.title: A Reassuring Chat on the Fasting Ladder
shaban_prep.subtitle: Agreeing gently ahead of time around health, age, and readiness
steps: Review the Fasting Ladder together and notice your child's comfortable step.
Remind them that resting or eating whenever tired or unwell is caring for the trust of their body.
shaban_prep.child_role: Pick a gentle goal—or a helping role at home if you are under seven.

shaban_prep.title: The Kind-Words Jar & Charity Box
shaban_prep.subtitle: Readying a generous heart and gentle speech before Ramadan arrives
steps: Place a small charity box alongside an empty jar for thankful notes.
Invite everyone to place one thank-you drawing or kind note inside before bedtime.
shaban_prep.child_role: Decorate the box and jar with simple paper cutouts.

shaban_prep.title: Short Surahs for the Iftar Table
shaban_prep.subtitle: Warming up the family wird so little hearts recognize it with joy
steps: Browse the short surahs of the family wird and listen softly to one surah after Isha.
Share one simple meaning of an ayah in warm, everyday words.
shaban_prep.child_role: Repeat two short verses gently alongside a parent before sleep.

shaban_prep.title: Reaching Out to Grandparents
shaban_prep.subtitle: Entering the blessed month with soft hearts and family warmth
steps: Make a brief call to grandparents or close relatives where your child shares a warm greeting.
End the evening with a forgiving word among siblings at home.
shaban_prep.child_role: Send a cheerful voice greeting to grandparents.

shaban_prep.title: Iftar Table Ambassador Card
shaban_prep.subtitle: Giving every child a meaningful, joyful helper role before Maghrib
steps: Ask each child which small table task they enjoy most: dates, water cups, napkins, or Bismillah.
Keep their card near the table so they take pride in serving every evening.
shaban_prep.child_role: Practice passing a water cup or dates dish gently with Bismillah.

shaban_prep.title: Calm Ten Minutes Before Sunset
shaban_prep.subtitle: Swapping pre-iftar screen restlessness for quiet audio storytelling
steps: Agree together that the final fifteen minutes before Maghrib stay screen-free.
Try one short screen-off audio story together so calm becomes the house rhythm.
shaban_prep.child_role: Rest the phone down and listen with calm eyes for two minutes.

shaban_prep.title: Three Duas Tucked Away for Ramadan
shaban_prep.subtitle: Connecting the child's heart to hopeful dua before the crescent
steps: Each family member picks one heartfelt dua to repeat before breaking fast.
Speak simply about how near and responsive Allah is to sincere whispers.
shaban_prep.child_role: Choose a warm dua you want to ask Allah for yourself and your family.

shaban_prep.title: Crescent Watch & Joyful Welcome
shaban_prep.subtitle: Welcoming Ramadan with gratitude, calm, and readiness
steps: Look at the evening sky together and give thanks for reaching another Ramadan in health.
Prepare a light suhoor while asking Allah for gentleness and steadiness.
shaban_prep.child_role: Dim the bright lights early and help ready the suhoor table.

eid_greetings.eyebrow: From Our Family Home to Yours
eid_greetings.headline: Eid Mubarak — May Allah Accept From Us & You
lines: Throughout Ramadan we lit quiet lanterns of Quran, kindness, and dua together.
We send warm prayers that Allah fills your home with lasting peace and joy.
eid_greetings.closing: Warmest wishes for a blessed Eid

eid_greetings.eyebrow: Warm Eid Greeting for Loved Ones
eid_greetings.headline: May Allah Accept Your Deeds & Bless You
lines: Eid joy is brighter with your warmth, your wisdom, and your dua.
We pray Allah grants you lasting health, comfort, and serenity.

eid_greetings.eyebrow: A Gentle Card Carrying Ramadan Light
eid_greetings.headline: May Your Lanterns Shine Through Shawwal
lines: We stepped out of Ramadan holding two small habits close with love.
May Allah bless your household and nurture every good intention.

eid_greetings.headline: Wishing Your Home Peace & Faith
lines: Worship and shared tables gathered us in Ramadan, and gratitude gathers us on Eid.
May Allah make it a feast of harmony and bright hearts.
eid_greetings.closing: Blessed Eid to your entire family

eid_greetings.headline: Eid Joy, Ease, and Kindness
lines: A quiet Eid greeting sent with sincere affection on this bright morning.
May your days ahead overflow with goodness and gentle companionship.

eid_greetings.headline: Praise Be to Allah for His Blessings
lines: Thankful to Allah who brought us through Ramadan in health, Quran, and reflection.
May He accept our small steps and bring your family countless blessings.
eid_greetings.closing: Taqabbal Allahu Minna wa Minkum — Eid Mubarak
